text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold D, E, A and C after gains; I should avoid letting a quick rise alone decide when to sell and consider each holding's longer-term prospects.","I added to B in two separate periods and later bought E and A; before adding, I should check that the investment still fits my plan rather than react to recent price moves.","My account value rose overall, but short-term changes were modest; I should judge decisions over time, review all five stocks periodically and keep enough cash for flexibility."]}
